scope: Conservative compound preflight for supplied existing entities on layers locked by preceding ReplaceLayer operations, including nested groups and chained replacements.
red_before: A nested lock-then-move partly changed the layer and lost redo before preflight.

validation.binding_plan_checks: full, actual PR base, and worktree inventory passed; 31 checker regressions passed
tests: red-before nested lock and edit preserves state and redo

limitations: Conservative refusal also covers copy/read-only supplied entities following a lock transition.
Entities created earlier in the compound and custom operations that fetch other objects are not covered.
Forced retry using stale entity snapshots can retain old layer metadata; requires separate correction.
Native GUI and hosted platform qualification remain open.
